definitions.gloss: to buy up, to purchase outright
definitions.explanation: To purchase something outright, often used for buying back, buying used goods, or acquiring something in full.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{取|と}る。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧{買|か}い{取|と}って⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: This shop buys brand-name goods at good prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧になった⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{買|か}い{取|と}って⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a secondhand shop buy the furniture I no longer needed.

notes:
{買|か}い{取|と}る means to purchase something outright, often used for secondhand goods, trade-ins, and buybacks.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{取|と}る

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧{買|か}い{取|と}る: to buy at a high price
- ⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧{買|か}い{取|と}る: to buy at a low price
- {買|か}い{取|と}って⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to have someone buy (from you)
- {買|か}い{取|と}り⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧: specialty buyback shop

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{買取|かいとり}→買取：14366_kaitori⟧: purchase, buyback (noun form)
- ⟦{買取|かいとり}→買取：14366_kaitori⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: buyback price
- ⟦{下取|したど}り→下取り：16386_shitadori⟧: trade-in

USAGE:
Very common in the context of secondhand shops (⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧), used bookstores (⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧), and electronics resellers. Signs reading ⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧⟦{買取|かいとり}→買取：14366_kaitori⟧ (we buy at high prices) are common.
